# Savings goal

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/savings/

Turn a savings target into a simple monthly contribution plan. Subtract what you have already saved and spread the remaining amount across your timeline.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

For an NPR 300000 goal with NPR 50000 saved, calculate the monthly amount needed over 12 months.

## Limits and checks

This simple plan assumes no interest or investment return. A balance above the goal results in no further monthly contribution.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
